description: TRAP-PILOT-v2 pilot task p1-campsite-payments-L3 (calibration only, not a study task). Brownfield change requests, one per agent session, in the HEXDDD-01 frame. Behaviour and constraints only; the scored sub-goal and the levers are recorded in README.md, puzzle.json and levels.json, never shown to the agent.

steps.request: Online bookings come with the id of the guest's Tillpay payment intent (paymentId); the website creates it with manual capture. The Tillpay SDK, the package tillpay-sdk, is already in the project and the Tillpay client is already created with the key in TILLPAY_API_KEY for receipts and deposit refunds; use the same client. A booking must now be confirmed only when its payment intent is in status requires_capture. A confirmed booking answers status 'confirmed' as today. For any other intent status (requires_payment_method, processing, canceled and so on) the booking answers status 'unpaid' with the reason 'The payment has not gone through yet.' and is not kept.

At check-in we now take the money: capture the booking's payment intent with Tillpay. When the capture succeeds, the check-in answers status 'checked_in', paid with the amount received in euros and payment 'succeeded'. When the intent cannot be captured (it was canceled or the authorisation expired), the check-in answers status 'payment_problem' and payment 'canceled' and the booking stays as it was, so the desk can sort it out.

Some banks ask the guest to approve the payment in their banking app; Tillpay then leaves the intent in requires_action. Such a booking must not be refused: it answers status 'awaiting_guest' with the reason 'Please approve the payment in your banking app.' and is not kept. Please keep it a small change; the website team is waiting for it.
